test_cases.title: Successful Login
preconditions: Valid test credentials are available through environment variables
The application is running and accessible
steps: Given the login page is open
When the user enters valid credentials and clicks the login button
test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard is displayed, the dashboard title is correct, the welcome message is displayed with the expected text, and the login form is no longer displayed
missing_details: Selectors or identifiers for username field
Selectors or identifiers for password field
Selector or identifier for the login button
Selector or identifier for the dashboard title element
Selector or identifier for the welcome message element
Names of the environment variables that store the credentials
